title: Sharp weighted estimates for the Bessel Riesz transform and its commutator with Andersen--Kerman weights
summary: Let $λ>-1/2$, $λ\neq0$, and let $Δ_λ=-\frac{d^2}{dx^2}-\frac{2λ}{x}\frac{d}{dx}$ be the Bessel operator on $\mathbb R_+=(0,\infty)$ studied by Muckenhoupt and Stein (TAMS 1965). Andersen and Kerman (Studia Math. 1981) proved that for $1<p<\infty$, the Bessel Riesz transform $R_λ=\frac{d}{dx}Δ_λ^{-1/2}$ is bounded on $L^p(\mathbb R_+,w(x)\,dx)$ if and only if $w$ is in the intrinsic class $A_{p,λ}$.
